IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'MapType_backup') BEGIN IF EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_Map_MapType' and object_name(parent_object_id) = 'Map_backup' and schema_name(schema_id) = 'dbo' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Map_backup] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_Map_MapType] END
drop table [dbo].[MapType_backup]; END
changeSet.rollback: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'MapType_backup') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[MapType]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [MapClass] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_MapType_MapClass] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [Description] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_MapType_CreatedOn] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_MapType_UpdatedOn] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_MapType] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
